主要内容: On July 14, 2015, Royal Bank of Canada announced plans to sell its Swiss Private Banking Business, Royal Bank of Canada (Suisse) SA (RBC Suisse), to SYZ Group. The transaction, subject to regulatory approvals, is expected to close in Q3 2015. RBC Suisse, based in Geneva, manages approximately CHF10 billion in assets under management as of October 31, 2014. The deal aims to enhance RBC Suisse's geographic focus and client service capabilities, particularly in emerging markets. RBC Wealth Management, part of the bank, is one of the world’s top five largest wealth managers, with over C$747 billion of assets under administration and C$481 billion under management. Royal Bank of Canada outlines key risks in its Q2 2015 Report to Shareholders, including anti-money laundering, growth in wholesale credit, high Canadian household debt, cybersecurity, and business/economic conditions in Canada, the U.S., and other operating regions. The report also addresses fiscal, monetary, and tax policy changes, employee retention, client information accuracy, distribution network integration, and various operational risks. The bank warns that this list is not exhaustive and other factors may affect results.
